title.en: I was going to call you

title.en: A year of training by June

es: Formar will have been + -ing para medir la duración de una actividad hasta un punto futuro y contrastarla con will have + participio.

teaching.es: Para junio llevaré un año entero entrenando para el maratón.

teaching.es: Para finales de mes, Ana llevará seis meses ahorrando dinero.

es: Coordinar un viaje familiar que cambió de planes: explicar el plan anterior, fijar plazos con by, proyectar una duración y cerrar un acuerdo con preguntas corteses.

teaching.en: We were going to stay in a hotel, but we will rent a house instead.
teaching.es: Íbamos a alojarnos en un hotel, pero alquilaremos una casa.
teaching.explanationEs: Was going to + verbo: el plan anterior; will + verbo: la decisión actual.
segments: We were going to stay in a hotel,
but we will rent a house instead.
teaching.audioText: We were going to stay in a hotel, but we will rent a house instead.

teaching.en: We need to book the tickets by Friday.
teaching.es: Tenemos que reservar los billetes antes del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: By + momento: el plazo máximo para hacerlo.
segments: We need to book
the tickets by Friday.
teaching.audioText: We need to book the tickets by Friday.

teaching.en: The deadline for the deposit is the twentieth of June.
teaching.es: El plazo para pagar el anticipo es el veinte de junio.
teaching.explanationEs: Deadline + for: a qué corresponde el plazo.
segments: The deadline for the deposit
is the twentieth of June.
teaching.audioText: The deadline for the deposit is the twentieth of June.

teaching.en: By the day we leave, Dad will have been saving for this trip for a year.
teaching.es: Para el día de la salida, papá llevará un año ahorrando para este viaje.
teaching.explanationEs: Will have been saving + for: la duración proyectada hasta la salida.
segments: By the day we leave, Dad will have
been saving for this trip for a year.
teaching.audioText: By the day we leave, Dad will have been saving for this trip for a year.

teaching.en: Would it be possible to confirm the dates today?
teaching.es: ¿Sería posible confirmar las fechas hoy?
teaching.explanationEs: Would it be possible to + verbo: una petición cortés.
segments: Would it be possible to
confirm the dates today?
teaching.audioText: Would it be possible to confirm the dates today?

teaching.en: Then we all agree: we leave on the first of August.
teaching.es: Entonces todos estamos de acuerdo: salimos el uno de agosto.
teaching.explanationEs: Agree cierra el acuerdo con la información final.
segments: Then we all agree: we leave
on the first of August.
teaching.audioText: Then we all agree: we leave on the first of August.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta: «Hay que pagar antes del lunes.»

choices.text: We must pay until Monday.
We must pay since Monday.
We must pay by Monday.

feedback.es: By marca el plazo máximo para hacer algo; until y since no expresan un límite de entrega.

hint.es: Piensa en la fecha límite, no en cuánto dura algo.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Sería posible pagar el anticipo la semana que viene?»

feedback.es: Would it be possible to + verbo forma una petición cortés.

hint.es: Es la palabra que une possible con el verbo.

origin.text: Would it be possible ___ pay the deposit next week?

hint.es: El plan anterior va en pasado y la decisión nueva en futuro.
